## What it is

The mounting ring. The four M3 holes and the Ø19 cable window are the deck pattern and did not move. The slots are under the bars, and the centre hole is Ø44.8 mm.

## Design notes

- Each slot is 18.4 × 10.2 mm, the 18.2 × 10.0 mm bar end plus 0.2 mm. A tooth matches that tower's notch.
- The centre hole stops 2.4 mm short of the cable window. The slots would have allowed a larger hole.
- A recessed digit sits just inboard of each slot.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't fill the middle of the ring. The cable window has to stay open.
- Don't move the four M3 holes or the cable window. Those are the deck.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: unchanged. The new bars use the same slots.
